{{Top}}
A '''maggot''' was a type of creature. The [[muscle maggot]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], while the [[grain maggot]] was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The [[screw maggot]] was native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] and [[gravel-maggot]]s lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Diptera maggot]] was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

[[Qawohl]] was an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who was referred to as "Maggot."
